results.description: Aloneness or Loneliness? (3033873597)
results.text: Perhaps it is a fine line, but as a very sparsely populated, expansive-- and moving into winter-- dark place, Iceland can offer you plenty of time, space for reflective alone time... or toss you into an abyss of isolation. My measure seems to fluctuate with the ins and outs of my internet connection. This month in Iceland was an opportunity I could not refuse and am glad I have not done so. It is quite different living in a different culture versus visiting as a tourist or a parachuting presente Aloneness or Loneliness? (3033873597)

results.description: Office With a View (2159365780)
results.text: Some things shifting in 2008... I will be working more from my "remote" office, in the big metropolis of http://www.city-data.com/city/Strawberry-Arizona.html (maybe 1029 soon). My view beyond twitter on the laptop, is to Strawberry Mountain, past the clattering birds in the feeders outside the window. The woodstove is keeping me warm with today's temps in the low 40s... the internet is coming in via a satellite connection, which is.... well, not optimal all the time, but I'm working on it.
